endorsements.name: Lisa Gnedt
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-32919
endorsements.description: Use of an insecure temporary directory in the Windows License plugin for the Checkmk Windows Agent allows Privilege Escalation. This issue affects Checkmk: from 2.4.0 before 2.4.0p13, from 2.3.0 before 2.3.0p38, from 2.2.0 before 2.2.0p46, and all versions of 2.1.0 (EOL).
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.8)
